mechanism_narrative: The upward revision in first-quarter GDP (GDPC1) to 23082.119 billion dollars signals strong economic growth, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Q1 2024 GDP revised upward to 23082.119 billion dollars
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 > 23000 billion dollars.

mechanism_narrative: A Fed funds rate above 5.0% signals restrictive monetary policy, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 101.0 and housing starts (HOUST) rises above 1300.0, it signals a weakening manufacturing sector but strong housing market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:June 2024 INDPRO revised to 100.863 and HOUST revised to 1316.0
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 101.0 AND HOUST > 1300.0.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 310.0) during restrictive monetary policy signals elevated recession risk, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 310.0.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: When employment (PAYEMS) falls below 158000 and unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.0%, it signals a weakening labor market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:June 2024 PAYEMS revised to 157695.0 and UNRATE at 4.1%
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS < 158000 AND UNRATE > 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 101.0 signals a weakening economy, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 101.0.

mechanism_narrative: A Fed funds rate below 5.0% signals accommodative monetary policy, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 5.0.
